title: Add a section to a README
prompt: Add a section "## Install" to README.md, between the introduction and "## Usage". It should say that the tool is installed with the command `pip install tidy-notes`, written in a code block. Keep the rest of the file as it is.

texts: A small tool that sorts the notes in a folder by date.
Run `tidy-notes ./notes` to sort the notes in `./notes`.
